title: Extract an attribute or S4 slot by name.

origin.description: This operator extracts or sets attributes for regular objects and S4 fields for S4 objects.
origin.details: Unlike `@`, this operator extracts attributes for any kind of objects.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(rlang))
x <- structure(NA, test = 42, tag = "x")
cat(sprintf("%s %s %s", x %@% "test", x %@% tag, if (is.null(x %@% "nope")) "NULL" else "notnull"))

translation.description: Extract an attribute or S4 slot by name.

arguments.name: x, name
arguments.description: Object and attribute or slot name (string or symbol-like).

translation.details: Missing names return None, matching R NULL with exact attribute lookup.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from rlang.slot import WithAttrs, slot

x = WithAttrs(None, {"test": 42, "tag": "x"})
missing = slot(x, "nope")
print(f"{slot(x, 'test')} {slot(x, 'tag')} {'NULL' if missing is None else 'notnull'}")
